# Role Configuration

Roles are project responsibilities. Agent bindings are configurable defaults.

## Default Bindings

| Role | Default agent | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Architect | Codex; scoped Claude exception for the v6.9 site mock-up work on `arch/canonical-v69-pivot` (2026-10-06; see below) | Creates feature maps, causal sequencing, protected seams, and feature-to-task guidance. |
| Planner | Codex (Claude exception ended at the 2026-10-03 21:23 reset; see below) | Converts reviewed feature guidance into small UI-verifiable task definitions. |
| Implementer | Claude | Builds the active task, runs checks, and prepares the review packet. |
| Reviewer | Configurable independent agent; Codex by default (see below) | Reviews work independently from the author. |

## Rules

- Keep role responsibilities stable even if the bound agent changes.
- Do not assume Planner, Architect, or Implementer means a specific vendor unless
  this file says so.
- Implementer may refine implementation steps, but should not redefine feature
  sequencing without Architect or user review.
- Reviewer must be independent from the agent that authored the implementation.
- Claude Code commands in `.claude/commands/` should read this file before
  acting so they can either run the role or prepare a handoff for the configured
  agent.

## Decision Requests Go To The Active Architect

Set by the owner on 2026-10-04 (verbatim in `.agent/owner-T028-closeout-2026-10-04.md`):
"for all decsion requests, let the active architect make them and inform me if
the architect wants me to weigh in as well with its justification and decision".

So the coordinator does not put decision requests to the owner. It sends them
to the Architect bound above, which decides, records the decision with its
justification, and informs the owner. Where the Architect wants the owner to
weigh in, it says so, giving its decision and justification, and the owner may
confirm or overrule. Owner acceptance of a slice (USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED) is notdelta and merge mechanism), T025f (template fingerprints and lineage) and T025greturned at 18:21 the same day and the binding was reverted at 18:53, so the
exception is closed and the rule below applies again without qualification.

Two Architect passes were produced under the exception, both on
`arch/queue-review-feedback` and both merged: the queue resequencing at
`2970d74` and the hardening-gate removal at `e02d267`. A later reader checking
who authored them should know they were Claude by an explicit, recorded
decision rather than by the coordinator routing around this file.

The lesson worth keeping is the one the exception was written to respect: when
a binding has to change, change it here first and then act. Routing around a
control is worse than the mistake the control prevents.

## Invoking A Codex-Bound Role

A role bound to Codex is run by invoking Codex, not by dispatching the
same-named Claude subagent and merging what it returns. Codex is on PATH and
runs non-interactively:

```
codex exec "<the role brief>"
```

**The obligation is the coordinator's, not the subagent's.** On 2026-09-23 the
Architect correctly flagged three times that it was producing Architect output
while this file bound the role to Codex. Each time the coordinator relayed the
flag to the user as a question and merged the output anyway. A subagent noticing
a binding violation is not a control, because it has already done the work by
the time it can tell anyone. The control is that the coordinator invokes the
bound tool in the first place.

So: before dispatching `assetops-architect` or `assetops-planner`, check the
binding above. If it is Codex, run `codex exec`. The Claude subagents of those
names refuse Codex-bound work rather than producing it.

## The Reviewer Binding, And Its Backup

The Reviewer is **Codex by default**. When Codex is unavailable - usage limit,
outage, or a reset hours away - the backup is a **fresh Claude
`assetops-reviewer` subagent**, and the substitution needs no permission. A
slice waiting a day for quota is worse than a slice reviewed by the weaker of
two independent readers.

**Independence is the rule the backup must not break.** The backup is a NEW
agent instance. It is never the agent that implemented the slice, and never
that agent resumed with a different instruction. An implementer asked to
review its own work will confirm it, which is why the binding exists.

State in the report which reviewer produced it. A Claude review of Claude
implementation is genuinely weaker than a Codex one on the same slice, and a
later reader deciding how much weight to give a verdict needs to know which
they are reading. Where the substitution happened because of quota, say so and
say what was left unjudged, so the question can go back to Codex if it matters
enough to wait for.

## Which Reviewer For Which Round

Set by the user on 2026-09-26 to conserve Codex quota, which has been the
binding constraint on this milestone three times. This is not the same as the
backup rule above: it applies whether or not Codex is available.

**Codex reviews discovery.** The first review of any slice, a contract version
move, a new mechanism or a restructure, and any round where the Implementer had
to choose between legitimate treatments. T020B's R1 was that round - state a
rule for unaligned windows or refuse them at setup - and it needed the stronger
reader.

**A fresh Claude `assetops-reviewer` reviews verification.** A correction round
where an independent reviewer has already named the defects and the fix needs
no design choice: prose, docstrings, claim corrections, test assertions,
deletions. The job is confirming the named items closed and nothing else moved.
Fresh rather than resumed, because there is no context worth preserving for
checking named sentences and a clean reader is worth more.

The honest risk, recorded so it is not discovered later: this relies on the
previous review having found everything discoverable in that area. Four
consecutive rounds on T020B each found something the last missed, which is the
argument against cheap re-reviews. **So a Claude verification pass that finds
something unexpected is a signal to escalate that round back to Codex, not a
cheap verdict to accept.** Finding an unnamed defect means the round was
discovery after all and was misclassified.

Two classification traps worth naming, both seen on T020B:

- **A correction round can widen under the Implementer's hand.** The R1a/R1b
  round was three sentences and a deletion when dispatched; it came back having
  also corrected an unnamed fourth sentence and added a property-based guard
  over thirteen windows. Classify on what came back, not on what was sent.
- **"Small" will drift to "everything" if it is not tested against the two
  lists above.** The question is not how many lines changed. It is whether a
  reader had to decide anything.

## Owner Review Routing From S3 Onward (2026-10-11)

Owner (verbatim, `.agent/owner-review-routing-and-merge-2026-10-11.md`): "codex usage optimizaion is important, so keep the same arragment for S2 going forward". For every slice from S3 onward: a fresh Claude `assetops-reviewer` does the slice's first review and every re-review; small written-list fix rounds run on a Sonnet implementer; one batched Codex review covers each milestone's slices together at the milestone's end; Codex Architect/Planner questions are batched rather than sent per question file. This overrides "Codex reviews discovery" below for per-slice first reviews; Codex remains the Architect, the Planner and the milestone reviewer.

## Do Not Write The Review In The Brief

Recorded on 2026-09-26 at the user's instruction, because this project had
been doing the opposite. Reviewer briefs had grown to eight numbered questions,
each naming the thing to judge and supplying the arguments on both sides. That
is not a brief; it is a draft verdict with blanks. A reviewer steered to eight
questions inspects eight things, and the ninth - the one nobody thought to ask
about - is the one that reaches production.

A brief gives the Reviewer:

- the target: branch, commit, spec, packet, and where prior reviews live;
- the standing criteria it is reviewing against, which live in the task file
  and this project's records, not in the brief;
- **what has already been run and verified**, with results, so quota is not
  spent re-running a green suite. This is factual and does not steer;
- the constraints: do not merge, do not fix, where to write, what not to touch.

A brief does **not** give the Reviewer:

- an enumerated list of what to judge;
- the arguments for or against a conclusion;
- which findings the coordinator considers important;
- a named preferred outcome, or a hint of one.

Pointing at an artifact is not steering; summarising what that artifact says is.
Where a genuine question must be asked - a decision only the user can take, a
constraint the Reviewer cannot infer - ask it plainly and separately, and do not
dress an opinion as a question.

The Implementer's packet already states its own uncertainties and residual
risks. That is the right channel for "look at this": the author declaring what
it is unsure of, in a document the Reviewer reads anyway.

## Sort Findings Before Forwarding Them

Recorded on 2026-09-26 after the user asked whether the Reviewer was applying
`D-2026-09-22-milestone-speed-over-purity`. It was; all three T020A1 reviews
cited it, and Codex used it to carry an HTTP-reachable 500, five overflow
sites and several residuals rather than block on them. **The coordinator was
the leak.**

That decision's stopping rule is narrow. Stop only for a defect expensive to
reverse, a claim that would mislead an Implementer, or a decision only the user
can take. **Everything else is recorded and carried.** A Reviewer that rates a
finding low and does not demand it has already applied the rule; forwarding it
as fix work overrides the Reviewer in the direction the decision forbids.

So when a review returns, the coordinator sorts every finding into block or
carry against those three conditions before putting any of it to the user, and
says which is which. A finding that is carried goes to
`.ai/MILESTONE_REVIEW_BACKLOG.md` with the reason, not into the next round.

T020A1 is the case to remember: five implementation rounds and three review
passes, of which two rounds closed comment counts, a docstring and a Draft
count that had drifted. Each was real. None was a reason to reopen a slice.

## Using Codex Efficiently

Codex quota is **account-level and shared across every model**. On 2026-09-24
it was exhausted twice in one day, the second time mid-review, and switching
to `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-sol` and `gpt-5.5` all returned the
identical limit with the identical reset time. **You cannot route around an
exhausted limit by changing model.** The only lever is spending less per call,
before the limit is reached.

What it cost that day, measured from the run logs:

| Pass | Tokens | Shell calls | Started |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Reviewer pass 1 | 145,247 | 31 | cold |
| Reviewer pass 2 | 145,568 | 38 | cold |
| Reviewer pass 3 | 25,259, then died | 5 | cold |

Pass 2 spent 145k tokens re-deriving what pass 1 had already established.

### Resume instead of restarting

`codex exec resume <session-id> "<follow-up prompt>"` continues an existing
session with its context intact. `--last` resumes the most recent. The session
id is printed in the header of every run, so **capture it whenever a Codex
role may be returned to** - which is every review, because a review that finds
defects is returned to by definition.

A second pass on the same slice is a follow-up, not a new engagement. Resume
it and say what changed. Start cold only when the subject is genuinely
different or the earlier session would mislead.

**`resume` does not take the same flags as `exec`, and this cost two failed
invocations on 2026-09-25 before it was pinned down.** Two rules:

- Options go **before** the session id: `codex exec resume [OPTIONS]
  <session-id> "<prompt>"`. After it they are parsed as the prompt.
- **`--sandbox` does not exist on `resume`.** Pass it as config instead:
  `-c sandbox_mode="workspace-write"`. `resume` accepts `-c`, `--last`,
  `--all`, `-m`, `--skip-git-repo-check`, `--json`, `-o` and a few others;
  run `codex exec resume --help` rather than assuming a flag carries over.

The working form, verified:

```
codex exec resume -c sandbox_mode="workspace-write" --skip-git-repo-check   <session-id> "<follow-up prompt>" < /dev/null
```

Both failures were argument parsing, rejected before any model call, so they
cost seconds and no quota. The point of recording them is that guidance which
fails on first use is worse than none.

A session resumes across a quota interruption: the third-pass review that died
mid-run at its usage limit was resumed the next day into the same session id
with its context intact.

### Match the model to the work

`-m <model>` selects one. `gpt-6-astra` is the default and the most expensive;
`gpt-6-sol` is the workhorse coding model; `gpt-6-luna` is the cheap one. Full
list: `gpt-6-astra`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`,
`gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-5.5`.

Reserve Astra for genuine architecture and review judgement. Mechanical passes
- a fix round against a written list, a routine Planner expansion, a
consistency sweep - do not need it.

### Never spend a full session on a probe

`~/.codex/config.toml` sets `model_reasoning_effort = "high"` globally, while
the models' own default is `low`. A one-line availability probe therefore runs
at high reasoning. If you must probe, use
`-m gpt-6-luna -c model_reasoning_effort=low`. Better: attempt the real work
and detect the limit from the error, which costs nothing when the limit is
already hit.

### Put verification in the brief, not in the session

Every fact the brief states is work the session does not repeat. Say what you
already ran and what you already verified - test counts, check results,
confirmed line numbers - and say plainly that repeating it is not wanted.
Ask Codex for judgement, not for re-running a green suite.

### Invocation mechanics that have already gone wrong

- **Pass the prompt as an argument, never on stdin.** `codex exec ... - < file`
  blocked for three hours with no output on 2026-09-23. Always redirect
  `< /dev/null`.
- **Do not double-background.** `nohup codex ... &` inside an already
  backgrounded call returns instantly, and the harness reports a completion
  that has not happened. Background the call once.
- **A branch carries a snapshot of these rules.** A session started on a task
  branch reads that branch's `.ai/`, not main's. Merge main into the branch
  before a review if a rule has changed.

## Using The Claude Implementer Efficiently

Set by the owner on 2026-09-29 after T023, T022B and T024 each cost 80-200M
re-read tokens and one to three hours. Measured from the transcripts: cost is
context size times turns, and context grew from resumed agents and from source
code read whole into context. The agent's own rules are in
`.claude/agents/assetops-implementer.md` "Context budget"; these are the
coordinator's:

- **A fresh implementer per build and per fix round. Never resume one.**
  T024's build started at 209k tokens because the read-only planning agent was
  resumed; T023's fix rounds started at 458k. If a slice needs a planning pass,
  the planner writes its plan to `.agent/T0NN-implementer-plan.md` and a fresh
  agent builds from that file.
- **Fix rounds run on Sonnet** (`model: sonnet` on dispatch), briefed with the
  review file and the findings to fix. New slices stay on the session model,
  where design judgement matters.
- **Keep slices small.** A task the implementer sizes at several times a
  previous slice is a split candidate before it is built, not after.
- **Build large slices in phases, a fresh agent per phase.** Set by the owner
  on 2026-09-29 after T025a: bounded reads cut read volume by about two thirds,
  but 508 turns still took context to 467k and cost 142M re-read tokens,
  because cost grows with the square of the turn count. A slice beyond one
  focused change is dispatched as phases (for example contracts and core, then
  model and setup, then Lab and frontend). Each phase ends with committed work
  and a short handoff at `.agent/T0NN-phase-N-handoff.md` (what landed, file
  anchors, what is next, open risks); the coordinator dispatches a fresh agent
  for the next phase from that file. Full suites and the packet belong to the
  last phase.
- **Hand off at about 120k context.** Set by the owner on 2026-10-02 after
  usage showed 66% of tokens spent above 150k context and 67% in implementer
  subagents. An implementer that nears 120k commits what is safe, writes its
  handoff and stops, even mid-phase; a fresh agent continues from the handoff.
  The coordinator plans phases so that none is expected to reach that size,
  splitting a phase into sub-phases (2a, 2b) rather than letting one run long.
- **Backend tests: focused per phase, full once per slice** (OPS-01,
  `backend/TESTING.md`). Each phase runs the focused and adjacent backend files
  it touched; the real-Postgres full suite runs once per slice, on the final
  revision, with the guide's normal command and JUnit zero-skip check.
  Reviewers (Claude or Codex) cite that same-revision full evidence and run
  focused files; they rerun the full suite only for a finding that needs it.
  Before any full run start `tools/keep-awake-during-tests.ps1` and cap the run
  at twice its expected wall time; a run past the cap is stopped and reported,
  never waited on. One full suite on this machine at a time.
- **Mechanical sub-steps run on Sonnet.** Work fixed by an agreed contract or
  handoff - tests written against a settled interface, an AC-by-AC evidence
  pass, closeout records - is dispatched with `model: sonnet`, like fix rounds.
  Steps that decide a design stay on the session model.

## Token Efficiency Without Lowering Quality (owner, 2026-10-18)

Owner: be very efficient without compromising quality, in every session. Lessons
from W1 rework and W2-00..W2-03 (about 30-40% avoidable rework, then 15-20%):

- **All acceptance rules in the brief from the start.** Layout contract,
  recurring-defect checklist, height rule, plain-language rules, proof list.
  Never introduce a rule mid-build; it forces trimming passes on every slice.
- **Build specs answer the known question classes before coding.** A W2+ build
  spec is ready only when it fixes, against the actual code: identifier
  grammars and formats; exact fixture Site/Foundation values and how bindings
  are published; every seam with path:symbol; guard allowlists the new code
  must satisfy (rule 8 writers, sqlalchemy import allowlist, dependency
  direction); refusal codes; freshness/time references; UI empty/unavailable
  copy and the panel map; how Lab/run projections and stored artifacts look.
  W2-02 needed six question rounds because its first spec skipped these.
- **Size builder runs to one spec commit each**, with a handoff after each, so
  no run dies mid-commit and the next run reads only the handoff.
- **Model by risk.** First review of a new build and design-deciding work on
  the session model; fix rounds, re-reviews (scoped to prior findings) and
  mechanical steps on Sonnet. A capture- or copy-only fix may be verified by
  the coordinator directly (view the evidence, record a short verify note).
- **Serialize slices that edit the same shared UI files**; parallelize only
  disjoint work (backend vs frontend, different domains).
- **One full suite per round, only when no builder is running.** Do not rerun
  full suites after doc-, test- or CSS-only changes; rerun the touched files.
- **Batch Architect/Planner questions into one Codex call**, and fold a
  preemptive sweep of the slice's remaining commits into that same call.
- **No duplicate agents.** Check for a live agent on a worktree before
  dispatching; never reuse a worktree a reviewer is still using.
- **Briefs point to files; they do not restate them.** Coordinator replies to
  interim agent notifications stay to one line.

## Updating Bindings

Change bindings here when the team wants a different tool to own a role. Record
material changes in `.ai/DECISIONS.md` if they affect workflow, review

## Selection, projection and capability

One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. The effective Foundation/binding is selected at each evidence source time (W2-03), with the selected policy at the requested window; conflicting/absent effective revision is an explicit limitation. 31 days maximum. No newer assessment, Finding or consequence may be silently mixed with an older `known_at`. A late accepted report makes the current projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new exact assessment and cold consequence both settle. A selected old cutoff is `HISTORICAL`, even when there is no pending work.

`ColdSiteReadService` joins, by exact UUIDs, W2-03 `ColdReadService` output, W2-01 Foundation, S4-05 source/publication links and the cold consequence head. It does not use a display-name join or the latest Finding irrespective of window. Capability claims are exactly `TEMPERATURE_POINT,EXCURSION_BOUNDS,BACKUP_START_RESULT,TRANSFER_POSITION,COOLING_RESPONSE,PRODUCT_EXPOSURE`. Each has `state:SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, `required_roles:string[]`, `missing_roles:string[]`, `coverage:{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal}` and `as_of,limitation`. `TEMPERATURE_POINT` requires GOOD calibrated room probe and attested clock; `EXCURSION_BOUNDS` adds policy, two qualifying samples and >=0.8 coverage with no >10-minute bridge; `BACKUP_START_RESULT` requires correlated accepted request/result and the W2-03 causal rules; `TRANSFER_POSITION` needs its own bound transfer report; `COOLING_RESPONSE` needs an accepted compressor state and probe series; `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` means bounded thermal exposure only and requires an eligible excursion. Contradictory accepted facts give `CONTRADICTORY`, not healthy/failure. Source `contact` and `fact_age` derive from recorded gateway diagnostic/contact plus accepted last fact separately; no source contact becomes equipment condition. Panel 3's â€œnext evidenceâ€ is simply a named missing role/link, never a scored recommendation.

Analysis rows are selected accepted public records from the pinned assessment basis and exact links, ordered `(source_time,evidence_id)`, with `evidence_id,kind,source_time,received_at,quality,role,exclusion,source_id,envelope_sha256,assessment_revision_id`; `exclusion` is W2-03's SUPPORT/CONTEXT/EXCLUDED reason or null. Keep a record in the list when excluded, label why, and link to the existing Site Evidence exact record when source gate permits. `claim_rules` lists rule ID `cold-excursion/1` or `cold-start-response/1`, requirement, observed/missing role, coverage and resulting limit, all derived from the selected assessment; no speculative prose rule. Opaque cursor encodes `(source_time,evidence_id)` and selected basis SHA; mismatch returns 409 rather than changing pages.

## Money schema `0023` and rules

Create four new tables (do not widen the mini-grid `financial_consequence_revision`, whose CHECK constrains `POTENTIAL_FUEL_COST`, `fuel-cost-1`, L and priced amount). All UUID references below are composite `(tenant_id,site_id,id)` FKs, including Site, FindingRevision, cold episode revision, assessment revision and accepted evidence. Add scoped unique targets to referenced tables only where `0022` has not already supplied them. All tables have `tenant_id,site_id`; every immutable row has server `created_at`/`finished_at`, with UPDATE/DELETE refusal triggers. Downgrade refuses while any of these rows exist; otherwise drops only W2-04 triggers/tables/indexes.

* `cold_consequence_revision`: `id uuid PK`, `finding_revision_id`, `episode_revision_id`, `assessment_revision_id` UUID NOT NULL; `revision_no int >0`, `prior_revision_id uuid NULL`; `kind` CHECK `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE|RECORDED_REPAIR`; `state` CHECK `UNPRICED|WITHHELD`; `reason` nonempty; `window_start,window_end timestamptz` with start<end; `room_asset_id uuid`; `overlap_group text`; `quantity_unit` CHECK `degC_min|none`; `quantity_low,quantity_high numeric NULL` nonnegative/ordered; `amount_low,amount_high numeric NULL`, `currency char(3) NULL`; `finding_basis_sha256,consequence_basis_sha256 char(64)`, `model_id` CHECK `cold-exposure/1|cold-repair/1`; `source_classification`, `source_gate_sha256 char(64)`, `assumption_revision_ids jsonb` array, `limitation text NULL`. Unique `(finding_revision_id,kind,revision_no)` and `(finding_revision_id,kind,consequence_basis_sha256)`. DB CHECK requires `amount_low IS NULL AND amount_high IS NULL AND currency IS NULL` for every row; a later approved migration must widen this. `RECORDED_REPAIR` is `UNPRICED`, quantity null/`none`, until an exact accepted cost feed and non-overlap rule exist. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` may carry nonnegative bounded `degC_min`; if insufficient evidence both bounds null. No zero amount or stock count stands for unknown.
* `cold_consequence_evidence`: `consequence_revision_id,evidence_id,use,reason` with PK `(consequence_revision_id,evidence_id,use)`, `use=SUPPORT|CONTEXT|EXCLUDED` and scoped FKs. Include all exact evidence cited by the pinned Finding/episode basis, no private world keys.
* `cold_consequence_work`: `id uuid PK`, `cause` CHECK `FINDING_REVISION_APPENDED|EPISODE_REVISION_APPENDED|ASSUMPTION_PUBLISHED|SOURCE_GATE_CHANGED`; typed nullable locators for FindingRevision/episode revision/assumption revision/source gate, `window_start,window_end`, `room_asset_id`, `dirty_key_sha256 char(64)`, `enqueued_at`; unique `(tenant_id,site_id,dirty_key_sha256)`. Trigger-only INSERT with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` on that named unique target. A trigger on cold FindingRevision and episode revision enqueues the shared Site/window/room; assumption/source-gate triggers enqueue only overlapping cold scopes. No runtime work insert/status update. Backfill existing W2-03 cold heads once during upgrade, idempotently.
* `cold_consequence_work_attempt`: `id uuid PK`, `work_id` scoped FK, `attempt_no int >0`, `outcome` CHECK `SUCCEEDED|FAILED`, `error_code text NULL`, `consequence_revision_ids jsonb` array, `finished_at`; unique `(work_id,attempt_no)`. Success has no error and exact returned IDs; failure has error and empty IDs. A failed attempt leaves work pending; pending means no successful attempt. Index `(site_id,enqueued_at)` and `(work_id,attempt_no DESC)`.

`overlap_group = 'cold:' + sha256(canonical JSON array [tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id])`. An excursion and backup Finding of the same selected room/window share it; the financial read groups `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` by this key and takes the single selected excursion exposure basis, never sums both. The start-response Finding may carry a `WITHHELD` context consequence with the same key but zero *counted* exposure entries, not a numeric zero. No cross-window summing without an explicit disjoint-window contract.

The source-gate event is an appended `batch_publication_link` to a previously accepted cold batch, if one exists; its trigger selects only cold heads whose linked accepted IDs use that batch and enqueues `SOURCE_GATE_CHANGED` inside the link transaction. An initial link before acceptance has no heads and creates no money work; later W2-03 Finding/episode append enqueues it. `evidence_publication` is immutable and a new unrelated publication never dirties an existing cold basis. `ASSUMPTION_PUBLISHED` watches `financial_assumption_revision` for only the three reserved cold keys; the current publisher refuses them, so this arm has no W2 fixture rows and future publication requires its own approval/migration. Each trigger derives the same canonical dirty key from `(cause,locator,tenant_id,site_id,window_start,window_end,room_asset_id)` and takes a Site advisory transaction lock before selecting heads, following `0012_evidence_consequence_work.py`'s enqueue lock pattern. No trigger on an accepted disposition bypasses W2-03 assessment: it waits for the new exact cold Finding/episode revision.

`cold-exposure/1` derives observed rectangle degree-minute bounds only from W2-03's persisted episode bounds/accepted evidence, not a continuous curve. A bounded positive or zero technical quantity is allowed only when W2-03 actually proved it; missing-probe/contradictory has null quantity. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is unpriced for sound technical bounds because no `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value`, reviewed `cold_exposure_rule`, product/currency binding or source-gated valuation exists. These are **reserved future scenario keys**, displayed as missing, not publishable via the diesel-price publisher. Product value/currency and EV tariff would be explicitly authored scenario assumptions and still would not prove sales, collections, spoilage or lost revenue. Recorded repair needs an accepted exact cost/currency/work record; none of the six replay cases has one. Mixed/unknown source, closed S4-05 gate, stale/pending assessment, incomplete period or contradictory evidence yields `WITHHELD` and null amount. LR current-money gate also refuses a current money claim from historical/pending basis. `exact_basis` returns selected Finding/episode/assessment UUIDs, accepted evidence UUIDs, source gate digest, assumption revision UUIDs (empty in W2) and consequence basis SHA. Basis SHA hashes canonical sorted IDs, window/cutoff, model/formula version, quantity bounds, source gate and missing assumption markers; an identical basis returns the existing ID and a changed basis appends a new revision.

`PostgresColdConsequenceStore` alone inserts `cold_consequence_revision`, `cold_consequence_evidence` and `cold_consequence_work_attempt`. `cold_recompute.process_one` selects unfinished work under `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cold_consequence:' || work_id,0))`, takes one repeatable-read snapshot, refuses a foreign/missing exact basis, writes consequence/links and `SUCCEEDED` attempt in one transaction. On derivation failure it rolls back that transaction and appends a typed `FAILED` attempt in a fresh transaction. A crash before success commits leaves no partial revision; retries are idempotent. `run` uses the existing `financials/recompute.py:retry_due_at` 1,2,4,8,16-minute schedule and bounded batch; one bad work item cannot starve others. Trigger-created work does not depend on a successful worker.

## Five API reads

`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{code}/cold`. Request query for all is `from,to,known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `after,limit` (default 50, max 200). Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. 401 unauthenticated, 403 tenant/source disclosure, 404 missing/wrong-type Site, 409 unresolved selected revision or cursor/basis conflict, 422 malformed/range/unknown query, 503 store unavailable use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.

| GET suffix | Exact additional response |
| --- | --- |
| `/overview` | `status:{state:OBSERVED_EXCURSION|NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED|UNKNOWN|CONTRADICTORY,claim_level,as_of,limitation}`, `objective:{text,policy_low_deg_c,policy_high_deg_c,room_asset_id,as_of,limitation}`, `temperature_summary:{latest_deg_c,latest_at,coverage:{known_points,expected_points,ratio},episode_count,claim_level,as_of,limitation}`, `backup_summary:{attempts,observed_success,observed_failure,unknown,latest_chain_id,as_of,limitation}`, `causal_strip:[{step:GRID|START_REQUEST|START_RESULT|GENERATOR|TRANSFER|BUS|COMPRESSOR|PROBE,state:OBSERVED|MISSING|CONTRADICTORY,at,evidence_id,as_of,limitation}]`, `findings:{count,items:[{finding_id,revision_id,title,claim_level,link}],as_of,limitation}`, `needs_attention:[{code,text,link,as_of,limitation}]`, `consequence_summary:{state:UNPRICED|WITHHELD|RECORDED,quantity:{low,high,unit:'degC_min'},amount:{low:null,high:null,currency:null},overlap_group,as_of,limitation}`, `links:{temperature,backup,findings,evidence,analysis,financials}`. The response includes W2-03 selected temperature points only through its linked read, never repackages model truth. |
| `/evidence` | `capabilities:[{claim,state,required_roles,missing_roles,coverage,as_of,limitation}]`, `sources:[{id,role,contact,fact_age,accepted_count,last_accepted_at,as_of,limitation}]`, `links:{analysis,foundation,temperature,backup}`. `contact` is `RECENT|STALE|NEVER|UNKNOWN`; `fact_age` is duration/null, never equipment condition. |
| `/evidence/analysis` | `accepted_records:{items:[{evidence_id,kind,source_time,received_at,quality,role,exclusion,source_id,envelope_sha256,assessment_revision_id,link,as_of,limitation}],next_cursor}`, `claim_rules:[{rule_id,requirement,observed_roles,missing_roles,coverage,result,as_of,limitation}]`, `links:{evidence,findings}`. No private oracle or rejected ordinal masquerades as accepted. |
| `/financials` | `consequences:[{id,kind,state,quantity_bounds:{low,high},quantity_unit,amount_bounds:{low:null,high:null},currency:null,reason,overlap_group,exact_basis,as_of,limitation}]`, `not_included:[{code:STOCK_VALUE_UNDECLARED|EXPOSURE_RULE_UNAPPROVED|SPOILAGE_UNPROVED|REPAIR_COST_ABSENT|SOURCE_GATE_WITHHELD,text,as_of,limitation}]`, `links:{assumptions,findings,evidence}`. Return one counted exposure per overlap group; the optional backup context row is marked nonadditive. |
| `/financial-assumptions` | `items:[{key,revision_id,value,unit,currency,valid_from,valid_to,recorded_at,source,as_of,limitation}]`, `missing_keys:['cold_stock_quantity','cold_stock_unit_value','cold_exposure_rule']` in this slice, `publication_state:'NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_W2'`, `links:{financials}`. `items=[]` for six canonical replays. This is a read-only explicit absence statement, not a publication form. |

Links carry the exact selected `from,to,known_at` and record/revision ID through route builders, URL encoded. The Site overview's Finding count counts distinct current Finding IDs, not episode revisions. `needs_attention` is ordered: pending recompute, probe gap, observed start failure, unknown transfer, missing policy; omit a code only when its predicate is false. No â€œnext actionâ€ link unless an actual W2-03 Finding or Evidence destination exists.

13:Expected points are the 13 five-minute instants 19:00 through 20:00 in `[19:00,20:05)`; coverage numerator is distinct qualifying probe timestamps, denominator 13 (general windows derive their own aligned count), capped at 1. Need `>=0.8`, with no inferred path across a >10-minute gap. Above upper or below lower policy needs two consecutive GOOD samples at least five minutes apart; return needs two consecutive values inside band by at least effective `cold-return-hysteresis`. Exposure Finding requires 15-minute low duration, >=0.8 coverage and source gate; otherwise POSSIBLE/UNKNOWN. No spoilage, part-failure or continuous curve claim. Normal -> `NO_EXCURSION_OBSERVED`. def build_cold_assessment_router(registry: ImportedSiteRegistry, reads: Any | None,
                                 access: Access = development_access,
                                 disclosure: Disclosure = allow_disclosure) -> APIRouter:
    router = APIRouter()

    def opened(request: Request, site_code: str, keys: frozenset) -> tuple[UUID, UUID, dict[str, Any]]:
        refusal = access(request, site_code)
        if refusal == 401:
            raise _Refused(401, "UNAUTHENTICATED", "Sign in to read cold-chain assessments.",
                           {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
        if refusal == 403:
            raise _Refused(403, "SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN", f"No access to Site {site_code!r}.")

        if unknown:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN", f"Unknown parameters {unknown}.")
        lo, hi, known = _instant(request, "from"), _instant(request, "to"), _instant(request, "known_at")
        if (lo is None) != (hi is None):
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_INVALID", "Give both 'from' and 'to', or neither.")
        if lo is not None and not lo < hi:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_INVALID", "'from' must be before 'to'.")
        if lo is not None and hi - lo > MAX_WINDOW:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_TOO_LONG", "A cold read window is at most 31 days.")
        try:
            site = registry.imported(site_code)
            tenant = registry.tenant() if site is not None else None

            raise _Refused(503, "COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE", str(error)) from error
        if site is None or tenant is None or site.site_type != COLD_SITE_TYPE:
            raise _Refused(404, "SITE_NOT_FOUND", f"No cold-chain Site {site_code!r} in this tenant.")

"""W2-03 commit 4: the selected cold assessment reads (`.agent/W2-03-build-spec.md` "Commit 4 - selected reads").

`GET /api/sites/{code}/cold/temperature`, `/cold/backup-chain`, `/cold/findings` and `/cold/findings/{id}` with
strict UTC `from`, `to` (half-open, at most 31 days) and `known_at` (default: the committed disposition watermark
at request start); the Finding list adds `cursor` and `limit` (default 50, max 200). Without `from`/`to` the read
uses the latest selected cold window at the cutoff. Refusals use `{error:{code,message}}`: 401/403 through the
Finding-route access seam (403 also when the `disclosure` seam refuses the Site's source disclosure), 404 for an
unknown, foreign or non-COLDCHAIN Site or unknown scoped Finding, 409 for a cursor of a changed selected basis,
422 for a malformed instant, range, limit or unknown parameter, 503 when a store cannot be read. A window with no
selected assessment is 200 `UNKNOWN` with null values and empty arrays.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Callable
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse

from assetops_backend.analytics.cold_reads import (
    DEFAULT_LIMIT,
    MAX_LIMIT,
    MAX_WINDOW,
    ColdCursorRefused,
    ColdReadUnavailable,
)
from assetops_backend.finding_api import Access, development_access
from assetops_backend.sites.cold_foundation import COLD_SITE_TYPE
from assetops_backend.sites.cutover import ImportedSiteRegistry
from assetops_backend.sites.ports import SiteStoreUnavailable

COLD_ROUTE = "/api/sites/{site_code}/cold"
WINDOW_KEYS = frozenset({"from", "to", "known_at"})
LIST_KEYS = WINDOW_KEYS | {"cursor", "limit"}
# (site_code, tenant_id, site_id) -> True when this caller may see the Site's source provenance.
Disclosure = Callable[[str, UUID, UUID], bool]


def allow_disclosure(site_code: str, tenant_id: UUID, site_id: UUID) -> bool:
    return True


class _Refused(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str, message: str, headers: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status, self.code, self.headers = status, code, headers


def _refusal(error: _Refused) -> JSONResponse:
    return JSONResponse(status_code=error.status, headers=error.headers,
                        content={"error": {"code": error.code, "message": str(error)}})


def _instant(request: Request, key: str) -> datetime | None:
    raw = request.query_params.get(key)
    if raw is None:
        return None
    try:
        at = datetime.fromisoformat(raw.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except ValueError:
        at = None
    if at is None or at.tzinfo is None or at.utcoffset() != timezone.utc.utcoffset(None):
        raise _Refused(422, "COLD_TIME_INVALID", f"'{key}' must be a UTC instant such as 2026-10-06T19:00:00Z.")
    return at


def build_cold_assessment_router(registry: ImportedSiteRegistry, reads: Any | None,
                                 access: Access = development_access,
                                 disclosure: Disclosure = allow_disclosure) -> APIRouter:
    router = APIRouter()

    def opened(request: Request, site_code: str, keys: frozenset) -> tuple[UUID, UUID, dict[str, Any]]:
        refusal = access(request, site_code)
        if refusal == 401:
            raise _Refused(401, "UNAUTHENTICATED", "Sign in to read cold-chain assessments.",
                           {"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"})
        if refusal == 403:
            raise _Refused(403, "SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN", f"No access to Site {site_code!r}.")
        unknown = sorted(set(request.query_params) - keys)
        if unknown:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN", f"Unknown parameters {unknown}.")
        lo, hi, known = _instant(request, "from"), _instant(request, "to"), _instant(request, "known_at")
        if (lo is None) != (hi is None):
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_INVALID", "Give both 'from' and 'to', or neither.")
        if lo is not None and not lo < hi:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_INVALID", "'from' must be before 'to'.")
        if lo is not None and hi - lo > MAX_WINDOW:
            raise _Refused(422, "COLD_WINDOW_TOO_LONG", "A cold read window is at most 31 days.")
        try:
            site = registry.imported(site_code)
            tenant = registry.tenant() if site is not None else None
        except SiteStoreUnavailable as error:
            raise _Refused(503, "COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE", str(error)) from error
        if site is None or tenant is None or site.site_type != COLD_SITE_TYPE:
            raise _Refused(404, "SITE_NOT_FOUND", f"No cold-chain Site {site_code!r} in this tenant.")
        if reads is None:
            raise _Refused(503, "COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE", "No product database is configured.")
        if not disclosure(site_code, tenant.id, site.id):
            raise _Refused(403, "COLD_SOURCE_DISCLOSURE_FORBIDDEN",
                           f"The source provenance of Site {site_code!r} may not be disclosed to this caller.")
        return tenant.id, site.id, {"lo": lo, "hi": hi, "known_at": known}

    def served(work: Callable[[], Any]) -> Any:
        try:
            return work()
        except _Refused as error:
            return _refusal(error)
        except ColdCursorRefused as error:
            return _refusal(_Refused(error.status, error.code, str(error)))
        except ColdReadUnavailable as error:
            return _refusal(_Refused(503, "COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE", str(error)))

    @router.get(COLD_ROUTE + "/temperature")
    def temperature(request: Request, site_code: str) -> Any:
        def work():
            t, s, w = opened(request, site_code, WINDOW_KEYS)
            return reads.temperature(t, s, site_code, w["lo"], w["hi"], w["known_at"])
        return served(work)

    @router.get(COLD_ROUTE + "/backup-chain")
    def backup_chain(request: Request, site_code: str) -> Any:
        def work():
            t, s, w = opened(request, site_code, WINDOW_KEYS)
            return reads.backup_chain(t, s, site_code, w["lo"], w["hi"], w["known_at"])
        return served(work)

    @router.get(COLD_ROUTE + "/findings")
    def findings(request: Request, site_code: str) -> Any:
        def work():
            t, s, w = opened(request, site_code, LIST_KEYS)
            raw = request.query_params.get("limit")
            limit = DEFAULT_LIMIT
            if raw is not None:
                if not raw.isdigit() or not 1 <= int(raw) <= MAX_LIMIT:
                    raise _Refused(422, "COLD_LIMIT_INVALID", f"'limit' must be 1 to {MAX_LIMIT}.")
                limit = int(raw)
            return reads.findings(t, s, site_code, w["lo"], w["hi"], w["known_at"],
                                  request.query_params.get("cursor"), limit)
        return served(work)

    @router.get(COLD_ROUTE + "/findings/{finding_id}")
    def finding(request: Request, site_code: str, finding_id: str) -> Any:
        def work():
            t, s, w = opened(request, site_code, WINDOW_KEYS)
            try:
                fid = UUID(finding_id)
            except ValueError:
                raise _Refused(404, "COLD_FINDING_NOT_FOUND", "No such cold Finding.") from None
            body = reads.finding(t, s, site_code, fid, w["lo"], w["hi"], w["known_at"])
            if body is None:
                raise _Refused(404, "COLD_FINDING_NOT_FOUND", "No such cold Finding in this Site and window.")
            return body
        return served(work)

    return router

"""Site financial assumption publication: the pure contract (S4-02a phase 1).

`D-2026-10-13-s4-bounded-financial-basis`; packet `tasks/S4-02a-site-assumptions.md` items 1-2.

A publication is one explicitly authored Site price with a stored `change_kind`. This module validates it
(typed 422 refusals), derives the canonical request digest an exact retry is compared against, and plans
how the publication changes the Site/key series' current assignments (typed 409 refusals). It does no I/O:
the PostgreSQL store runs the plan under the series lock with one server instant.

Overlap rules (packet item 2, review C1):
- INITIAL: the first price, or one covering time with no current price. May be backdated. Refused if its
  authored range overlaps any current assignment.
- SUCCESSION: `valid_from` >= the server `recorded_at`. It may only shorten the single open-ended current
  assignment that strictly contains `valid_from`; any other overlap, or none at all, is refused.
- CORRECTION: backdated or bounded, with a reason. Supersedes every current assignment it overlaps and
  re-assigns the uncovered left/right remainders to their same old revisions. Refused if it overlaps nothing
  (that is an INITIAL) or is a future open-ended change (that is a SUCCESSION).
"""

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

ASSUMPTION_KEYS = ("diesel_price_per_litre",)
UNIT = "currency/L"
BASES = ("AUTHORED_ESTIMATE", "CONTRACT_RATE", "RECORDED_PURCHASE")
CHANGE_KINDS = ("INITIAL", "SUCCESSION", "CORRECTION")
SYSTEM_CHANNELS = ("SYSTEM_CLI", "SYSTEM_FIXTURE")

class PublicationRefused(Exception):
    """A typed refusal: `status` is the HTTP-equivalent code (409 conflict, 422 invalid)."""

    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"{code}: {message}")
        self.status = status
        self.code = code
        self.message = message


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Publication:
    assumption_key: str
    currency: str
    value: Decimal
    basis: str
    source_reference: str
    valid_from: datetime
    valid_to: datetime | None
    change_kind: str
    correction_reason: str | None
    # Explicit: None means "this is the first revision of the series", never "whatever is latest".
    expected_prior_revision_id: UUID | None
    idempotency_key: str
    channel: str
    provenance: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def parse_value(raw: str) -> Decimal:
    """An authored decimal string; floats and non-finite or negative values are refused."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise PublicationRefused(422, "VALUE_NOT_AUTHORED_DECIMAL", "The price must be an authored decimal string.")
    try:
        value = Decimal(raw.strip())
    except InvalidOperation as error:
        raise PublicationRefused(422, "VALUE_NOT_DECIMAL", f"{raw!r} is not a decimal number.") from error
    return value


def validate(p: Publication) -> None:
    def refuse(code: str, message: str) -> None:
        raise PublicationRefused(422, code, message)

    if p.assumption_key not in ASSUMPTION_KEYS:
        refuse("UNKNOWN_ASSUMPTION_KEY", f"Only {', '.join(ASSUMPTION_KEYS)} is supported.")
    if not (isinstance(p.currency, str) and len(p.currency) == 3 and p.currency.isascii()
            and p.currency.isalpha() and p.currency.isupper()):
        refuse("CURRENCY_NOT_ISO", "Currency must be an ISO 4217 three-letter upper-case code.")
    if not isinstance(p.value, Decimal) or not p.value.is_finite():
        refuse("VALUE_NOT_FINITE", "The price must be a finite authored decimal.")
    if p.value < 0:
        refuse("VALUE_NEGATIVE", "A price per litre cannot be negative.")
    if p.basis not in BASES:
        refuse("BASIS_NOT_OPERATIONAL", f"Basis must be one of {', '.join(BASES)}; a scenario is not published here.")
    if not (p.source_reference or "").strip():
        refuse("SOURCE_REQUIRED", "A source reference is required.")
    for name, at in (("valid_from", p.valid_from), ("valid_to", p.valid_to)):
        if at is not None and (not isinstance(at, datetime) or at.tzinfo is None or at.utcoffset() is None):
            refuse("VALIDITY_NOT_ZONED", f"{name} must be a timezone-aware instant.")
    if p.valid_to is not None and not p.valid_from < p.valid_to:
        refuse("VALIDITY_EMPTY", "valid_from must be before valid_to (half-open, non-empty).")
    if p.change_kind not in CHANGE_KINDS:
        refuse("UNKNOWN_CHANGE_KIND", f"change_kind must be one of {', '.join(CHANGE_KINDS)}.")
    reason = (p.correction_reason or "").strip()
    if p.change_kind == "CORRECTION" and not reason:
        refuse("CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED", "A correction must state its reason.")
    if p.change_kind != "CORRECTION" and p.correction_reason is not None:
        refuse("REASON_ONLY_FOR_CORRECTION", "Only a CORRECTION carries a correction reason.")
    if p.channel not in SYSTEM_CHANNELS:
        refuse("CHANNEL_NOT_SYSTEM", "Only the server-side SYSTEM publisher can publish in this slice.")
    if not (p.idempotency_key or "").strip():
        refuse("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED", "An idempotency key is required.")

"""S4-02a phase 1: Site financial assumption revisions and bitemporal assignments.

`D-2026-10-13-s4-bounded-financial-basis`; packet `tasks/S4-02a-site-assumptions.md`
"Persistence, publication and read contract" items 1-2.

`financial_assumption_revision` is one immutable, explicitly authored Site price
(value, currency, unit, basis, source, authored `[valid_from, valid_to)` intent,
server `recorded_at`, server actor, channel, authorization basis, provenance,
publication `change_kind` and idempotency key). It is append-only: a price row is
never rewritten.

Effective validity lives in `financial_assumption_assignment` (review carry M1):
each row assigns one revision to `[valid_from, valid_to)` over recorded time
`[recorded_from, recorded_to)`. Rows are immutable except a set-once
`recorded_to` (as `foundation_revision.superseded_at`). The GiST exclusion over
both axes means no two assignments of a Site/key ever overlap in valid time at
any recorded instant, so a superseded row stays selectable at older cutoffs. A
two-table trigger requires every assignment's valid range to lie inside its
revision's authored range, and its recorded start to be no earlier than the
revision's `recorded_at` nor than the series' latest `recorded_from`.

Revision ID: 0010_financial_assumptions
Revises: 0009_finding_store
Create Date: 2026-10-13

CREATE TABLE financial_assumption_revision (

Contradictory accepted facts give `CONTRADICTORY`, not healthy/failure. Source `contact` and `fact_age` derive from recorded gateway diagnostic/contact plus accepted last fact separately; no source contact becomes equipment condition. Panel 3's “next evidence” is simply a named missing role/link, never a scored recommendation.

"""W2-03 commit 4: selected cold reads (`.agent/W2-03-build-spec.md` "Commit 4 - selected reads" and the
"freshness reference for commit 4" amendment).

The pure currentness, freshness and cursor rules live here; the Postgres snapshot read is
`analytics/adapters/postgres_cold_reads.py:ColdReadService`. One REPEATABLE READ snapshot per request: the committed disposition watermark captured first, the latest DEFAULT
selection per analytic whose window covers the request and whose run cutoff is at or before `known_at`, its
assessment revision, the episode revisions of that revision and the cold Findings (`domain='cold_chain'`) whose
latest revision was known at the cutoff. Read-only; nothing here inserts. A missing selection is a valid
`UNKNOWN` read with null values and empty arrays; an unreachable store raises `ColdReadUnavailable` (503).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import binascii
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from uuid import UUID

from assetops_backend.analytics.assessment_inputs import iso

#: The probe recency limit of a CURRENT read.
PROBE_RECENCY = timedelta(minutes=10)
STATES = ("CURRENT", "PENDING_RECOMPUTE", "STALE_SOURCE", "HISTORICAL", "UNKNOWN")
MAX_WINDOW = timedelta(days=31)
DEFAULT_LIMIT, MAX_LIMIT = 50, 200
NO_SPOILAGE = "No spoilage, product-loss or failed-part determination is made."
PENDING_NOTE = ("Newer accepted evidence is waiting to be assessed; this is the previous selected result, "
                "not a current claim.")
HISTORICAL_NOTE = "Read at an earlier evidence cutoff; newer committed evidence exists."
NO_SELECTION_NOTE = "No selected cold assessment covers this window yet."
STALE_NOTE = "The latest usable probe reading is more than 10 minutes before the end of the window."
FUTURE_NOTE = "The window has not ended yet."
NO_PROBE_NOTE = "No usable probe reading in the selected window."


class ColdReadUnavailable(Exception):
    """The cold read store cannot be reached; the route answers 503, never an empty success."""


class ColdCursorRefused(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status, self.code = status, code


def probe_fresh(latest_probe_at: datetime | None, reference_at: datetime) -> bool:
    """The single probe-recency rule. `reference_at` is the selected half-open window's `to` boundary
    (Architect amendment 2026-10-18: window-scoped freshness, not live gateway contact or the wall clock)."""
    return latest_probe_at is not None and reference_at - latest_probe_at <= PROBE_RECENCY


def currentness_state(*, pending: bool, historical: bool, selected: bool, latest_probe_at: datetime | None,
                      window_to: datetime | None, now: datetime) -> str:
    """Amendment precedence: pending -> PENDING_RECOMPUTE; older explicit cutoff -> HISTORICAL; no settled
    selection, no qualifying probe or a future `to` -> UNKNOWN; stale probe at `to` -> STALE_SOURCE; else CURRENT."""
    if pending:
        return "PENDING_RECOMPUTE"
    if historical:
        return "HISTORICAL"
    if not selected or latest_probe_at is None or window_to is None or window_to > now:
        return "UNKNOWN"
    return "CURRENT" if probe_fresh(latest_probe_at, window_to) else "STALE_SOURCE"


def encode_cursor(anchor: datetime, finding_id: UUID, basis: str) -> str:
    raw = json.dumps({"basis": basis, "id": str(finding_id), "t": iso(anchor)}, sort_keys=True,
                     separators=(",", ":")).encode()
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(raw).decode().rstrip("=")


def decode_cursor(cursor: str, basis: str) -> tuple[datetime, UUID]:
    try:
        doc = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(cursor + "=" * (-len(cursor) % 4)))
        anchor = datetime.fromisoformat(doc["t"].replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        finding_id = UUID(doc["id"])
        held = doc["basis"]
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, binascii.Error) as error:
        raise ColdCursorRefused(422, "COLD_CURSOR_INVALID", "The cursor is not a cold Finding cursor.") from error
    if held != basis:
        raise ColdCursorRefused(409, "COLD_CURSOR_BASIS_CHANGED",
                                "The selected basis changed since this cursor was issued; reload the first page.")
    return anchor, finding_id

No trigger on an accepted disposition bypasses W2-03 assessment: it waits for the new exact cold Finding/episode revision.
 
 `cold-exposure/1` derives observed rectangle degree-minute bounds only from W2-03's persisted episode bounds/accepted evidence, not a continuous curve. A bounded positive or zero technical quantity is allowed only when W2-03 actually proved it; missing-probe/contradictory has null quantity. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is unpriced for sound technical bounds because no `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value`, reviewed `cold_exposure_rule`, product/currency binding or source-gated valuation exists. These are **reserved future scenario keys**, displayed as missing, not publishable via the diesel-price publisher. Product value/currency and EV tariff would be explicitly authored scenario assumptions and still would not prove sales, collections, spoilage or lost revenue. Recorded repair needs an accepted exact cost/currency/work record; none of the six replay cases has one. Mixed/unknown source, closed S4-05 gate, stale/pending assessment, incomplete period or contradictory evidence yields `WITHHELD` and null amount. LR current-money gate also refuses a current money claim from historical/pending basis. `exact_basis` returns selected Finding/episode/assessment UUIDs, accepted evidence UUIDs, source gate digest, assumption revision UUIDs (empty in W2) and consequence basis SHA. Basis SHA hashes canonical sorted IDs, window/cutoff, model/formula version, quantity bounds, source gate and missing assumption markers; an identical basis returns the existing ID and a changed basis appends a new revision.

## Five API reads

`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{code}/cold`. Request query for all is `from,to,known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `after,limit` (default 50, max 200). Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. 401 unauthenticated, 403 tenant/source disclosure, 404 missing/wrong-type Site, 409 unresolved selected revision or cursor/basis conflict, 422 malformed/range/unknown query, 503 store unavailable use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.

An episode with no warranted Finding still enqueues; the worker records a successful no-op attempt with an empty consequence ID array. No trigger on an accepted disposition bypasses W2-03 assessment: it waits for the new exact cold Finding/episode revision.
 
 `cold-exposure/1` derives observed rectangle degree-minute bounds only from W2-03's persisted episode bounds/accepted evidence, not a continuous curve. A bounded positive or zero technical quantity is allowed only when W2-03 actually proved it; missing-probe/contradictory has null quantity. `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` is unpriced for sound technical bounds because no `cold_stock_quantity`, `cold_stock_unit_value`, reviewed `cold_exposure_rule`, product/currency binding or source-gated valuation exists. These are **reserved future scenario keys**, displayed as missing, not publishable via the diesel-price publisher. Product value/currency and EV tariff would be explicitly authored scenario assumptions and still would not prove sales, collections, spoilage or lost revenue. Recorded repair needs an accepted exact cost/currency/work record; none of the six replay cases has one. Mixed/unknown source, closed S4-05 gate, stale/pending assessment, incomplete period or contradictory evidence yields `WITHHELD` and null amount. LR current-money gate also refuses a current money claim from historical/pending basis. `exact_basis` returns selected Finding/episode/assessment UUIDs, accepted evidence UUIDs, source gate digest, assumption revision UUIDs (empty in W2) and consequence basis SHA. Basis SHA hashes canonical sorted IDs, window/cutoff, model/formula version, quantity bounds, source gate and missing assumption markers; an identical basis returns the existing ID and a changed basis appends a new revision.

/** The heading id the Evidence landmark is labelled by. */
export const SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID = "site-evidence-heading";

/**
 * The operator route for one site's Evidence, addressed by `site_id`.
 *
 * It composes the same Site header and tab row the Foundation frame does, with
 * `Evidence` current, and a site that is not configured gets the same
 * statement of absence rather than an Evidence page for a site that does not
 * exist. Like every operator route it is never gated.
 *
 * The body is `SiteEvidence`: the T028 capability table (part B, scored by
 * the backend) above T027 part A - source health, per-signal coverage, the
 * mapping and configuration basis, rejections and the record inspector
 * drill-down, all read from accepted evidence only.
 */
export interface SiteEvidenceFrameProps {
  detail: SiteDetailClient;
  evidence: SiteEvidenceClient;
  analytics?: SiteAnalyticsClient;
  sitesPath: string;
}

export function SiteEvidenceFrame({
  detail,
  evidence,
  analytics,
  sitesPath,
}: SiteEvidenceFrameProps) {
  const { siteId } = useParams<{ siteId: string }>();
  const result = useSiteRecord(siteId, detail);
  const [params] = useSearchParams();

  if (result === null) {
    return (
      <main aria-labelledby={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}>
        <PageHeader title="Evidence" headingId={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID} />
        <p>Loading the configured site.</p>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (result.status === "not_found") {
    return (
      <main aria-labelledby={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}>
        <PageHeader
          title="Site not found"
          headingId={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}
        />
        <Panel
          heading="No such site"
          headingId="site-evidence-not-found-heading"
        >
          <p>
            No site with that site ID is configured, so there is no evidence to
            read. This is a statement that the site does not exist, not a site
            with no evidence.
          </p>
        </Panel>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (result.status === "unavailable") {
    return (
      <main aria-labelledby={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}>
        <PageHeader title="Evidence" headingId={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID} />
        <Panel
          heading="Site unavailable"
          headingId="site-evidence-unavailable-heading"
        >
          <p>
            The site store could not be read, so this site&apos;s evidence
            cannot be shown. This is a statement about the store: nothing is
            known about whether the site is configured.
          </p>
        </Panel>
      </main>
    );
  }

  const site = result.site;

  return (
    <main aria-labelledby={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}>
      <Breadcrumbs
        trail={[
          { label: "Sites", to: sitesPath },
          { label: site.display_name, to: siteDetailHref(site.site_id) },
          { label: "Evidence" },
        ]}
      />
      {/* W1-F2: the v69 Site page heading - site name, provenance badge, the screen's description. */}
      <SitePageHeader
        siteName={site.display_name}
        siteId={site.site_id}
        mode={deriveSiteView(site).sourceMode}
        description={SITE_SCREEN_DESCRIPTIONS[localView(params) === "analysis" ? "evidence-analysis" : "evidence"]}
        headingId={SITE_EVIDENCE_HEADING_ID}
      />
      <OperatorSiteTabs siteId={siteId} current="Evidence" />

def contact_document(facts: ContactFacts | None, absent: str = CONTACT_HEALTH_ABSENT) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Design section 3 D-I: CURRENT -> RECENT, STALE -> STALE, no diagnostic -> NEVER; a diagnostic whose
    freshness is UNKNOWN is STALE with a limitation, never a claim of recent contact. With no facts (no health
    store, or no matching selected gateway/diagnostic) the state is NEVER with as_of null and the `absent`
    limitation naming which read or match is missing (W2-01 contact null closure)."""
    if facts is None:
        return {"state": "NEVER", "as_of": None, "limitations": [absent]}
    if facts.received_at is None:
        return {"state": "NEVER", "as_of": None, "limitations": []}
    if facts.freshness == "CURRENT":
        return {"state": "RECENT", "as_of": _iso(facts.received_at), "limitations": []}
    if facts.freshness == "STALE":
        return {"state": "STALE", "as_of": _iso(facts.received_at), "limitations": []}
    return {"state": "STALE", "as_of": _iso(facts.received_at), "limitations": [CONTACT_UNVERIFIED]}

 ## Selection, projection and capability
 
-One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. The effective Foundation/binding is selected at each evidence source time (W2-03), with the selected policy at the requested window; conflicting/absent effective revision is an explicit limitation. 31 days maximum. No newer assessment, Finding or consequence may be silently mixed with an older `known_at`. A late accepted report makes the current projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new exact assessment and cold consequence both settle. A selected old cutoff is `HISTORICAL`, even when there is no pending work.
+One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. Determine probe freshness from the latest qualifying accepted probe `source_time` within `[from,to)` compared with `to`: over 10 minutes is `STALE_SOURCE`. Later wall-clock viewing of the 2026-10-06 replay never alone makes it stale or live. Precedence: overlapping queued/failed newer work -> `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`; explicit cutoff older than latest relevant committed disposition -> `HISTORICAL`; no settled selection/probe or future `to` -> `UNKNOWN`; old last probe -> `STALE_SOURCE`; otherwise `CURRENT`. Money can remain `UNPRICED` within a current technical read; pending/old/unresolved money has its own withholding limit.
 
-`ColdSiteReadService` joins, by exact UUIDs, W2-03 `ColdReadService` output, W2-01 Foundation, S4-05 source/publication links and the cold consequence head. It does not use a display-name join or the latest Finding irrespective of window. Capability claims are exactly `TEMPERATURE_POINT,EXCURSION_BOUNDS,BACKUP_START_RESULT,TRANSFER_POSITION,COOLING_RESPONSE,PRODUCT_EXPOSURE`. Each has `state:SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, `required_roles:string[]`, `missing_roles:string[]`, `coverage:{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal}` and `as_of,limitation`. `TEMPERATURE_POINT` requires GOOD calibrated room probe and attested clock; `EXCURSION_BOUNDS` adds policy, two qualifying samples and >=0.8 coverage with no >10-minute bridge; `BACKUP_START_RESULT` requires correlated accepted request/result and the W2-03 causal rules; `TRANSFER_POSITION` needs its own bound transfer report; `COOLING_RESPONSE` needs an accepted compressor state and probe series; `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` means bounded thermal exposure only and requires an eligible excursion. Contradictory accepted facts give `CONTRADICTORY`, not healthy/failure. Source `contact` and `fact_age` derive from recorded gateway diagnostic/contact plus accepted last fact separately; no source contact becomes equipment condition. Panel 3's “next evidence” is simply a named missing role/link, never a scored recommendation.

 Analysis rows are selected accepted public records from the pinned assessment basis and exact links, ordered `(source_time,evidence_id)`, with `evidence_id,kind,source_time,received_at,quality,role,exclusion,source_id,envelope_sha256,assessment_revision_id`; `exclusion` is W2-03's SUPPORT/CONTEXT/EXCLUDED reason or null. Keep a record in the list when excluded, label why, and link to the existing Site Evidence exact record when source gate permits. `claim_rules` lists rule ID `cold-excursion/1` or `cold-start-response/1`, requirement, observed/missing role, coverage and resulting limit, all derived from the selected assessment; no speculative prose rule. Opaque cursor encodes `(source_time,evidence_id)` and selected basis SHA; mismatch returns 409 rather than changing pages.

 ## Five API reads
 
-`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{code}/cold`. Request query for all is `from,to,known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `after,limit` (default 50, max 200). Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. 401 unauthenticated, 403 tenant/source disclosure, 404 missing/wrong-type Site, 409 unresolved selected revision or cursor/basis conflict, 422 malformed/range/unknown query, 503 store unavailable use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.
+`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{site_code}/cold`. Request query for all is optional paired `from,to`, optional `known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `cursor,limit` (default 50, max 200), matching W2-03's paging spelling. Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. Use one selected repeatable-read snapshot for W2-03, source disclosure and consequence heads. No previous consequence becomes a current money claim while a relevant cold work item is queued or failed. Errors use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.
 
+Refusal code contract (same scope and parse semantics as `cold_assessment_api.py:build_cold_assessment_router`): 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`; 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` or `COLD_SOURCE_DISCLOSURE_FORBIDDEN`; 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `COLD_SELECTION_UNSETTLED` for an explicitly requested revision that has no settled exact basis or `COLD_CURSOR_BASIS_CHANGED` for a changed Analysis basis; 422 `COLD_TIME_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_TOO_LONG`, `COLD_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN`, `COLD_LIMIT_INVALID`, or `COLD_CURSOR_INVALID`; 503 `COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE`. A wrong-type/foreign Site is 404 after access is checked. An absent optional current basis is 200 `UNKNOWN`, not a 409. Analysis cursor is unpadded base64url of sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON `{basis:<64 lowercase hex>,id:<UUID string>,t:<UTC instant>}`; malformed is 422 and an exact basis mismatch is 409. No arbitrary `after` offset or page across a changed basis.

def _cold_digest(parts: list[object], prefix: str = "cold:") -> str:
    return prefix + hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(parts).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def cold_event_id(*, scenario_sha256: str, device_id: str, signal_id: str, transition_ordinal: int) -> str:
    """`cold-` + SHA-256 of canonical `[scenario_sha256, device_id, signal_id, transition_ordinal]`.

    The V4 identifier grammar has no `:`; only report keys keep the `cold:` prefix."""
    return _cold_digest([scenario_sha256, device_id, signal_id, transition_ordinal], "cold-")

 ## Selection, projection and capability
 
-One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. The effective Foundation/binding is selected at each evidence source time (W2-03), with the selected policy at the requested window; conflicting/absent effective revision is an explicit limitation. 31 days maximum. No newer assessment, Finding or consequence may be silently mixed with an older `known_at`. A late accepted report makes the current projection `PENDING_RECOMPUTE` until a new exact assessment and cold consequence both settle. A selected old cutoff is `HISTORICAL`, even when there is no pending work.
+One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. Omitted `from,to` selects W2-03's latest settled cold window; exactly one omitted is 422. A selected old cutoff is `HISTORICAL`, even when there is no pending work. Determine probe freshness from the latest qualifying accepted probe `source_time` within `[from,to)` compared with `to`: over 10 minutes is `STALE_SOURCE`. Later wall-clock viewing of the 2026-10-06 replay never alone makes it stale or live. Precedence: overlapping queued/failed newer work -> `PENDING_RECOMPUTE`; explicit cutoff older than latest relevant committed disposition -> `HISTORICAL`; no settled selection/probe or future `to` -> `UNKNOWN`; old last probe -> `STALE_SOURCE`; otherwise `CURRENT`. Money can remain `UNPRICED` within a current technical read; pending/old/unresolved money has its own withholding limit.
 
-`ColdSiteReadService` joins, by exact UUIDs, W2-03 `ColdReadService` output, W2-01 Foundation, S4-05 source/publication links and the cold consequence head. It does not use a display-name join or the latest Finding irrespective of window. Capability claims are exactly `TEMPERATURE_POINT,EXCURSION_BOUNDS,BACKUP_START_RESULT,TRANSFER_POSITION,COOLING_RESPONSE,PRODUCT_EXPOSURE`. Each has `state:SUPPORTED|LIMITED|UNAVAILABLE|CONTRADICTORY`, `required_roles:string[]`, `missing_roles:string[]`, `coverage:{known_points:int,expected_points:int,ratio:decimal}` and `as_of,limitation`. `TEMPERATURE_POINT` requires GOOD calibrated room probe and attested clock; `EXCURSION_BOUNDS` adds policy, two qualifying samples and >=0.8 coverage with no >10-minute bridge; `BACKUP_START_RESULT` requires correlated accepted request/result and the W2-03 causal rules; `TRANSFER_POSITION` needs its own bound transfer report; `COOLING_RESPONSE` needs an accepted compressor state and probe series; `PRODUCT_EXPOSURE` means bounded thermal exposure only and requires an eligible excursion. Contradictory accepted facts give `CONTRADICTORY`, not healthy/failure. Source `contact` and `fact_age` derive from recorded gateway diagnostic/contact plus accepted last fact separately; no source contact becomes equipment condition. Panel 3's “next evidence” is simply a named missing role/link, never a scored recommendation.

 Analysis rows are selected accepted public records from the pinned assessment basis and exact links, ordered `(source_time,evidence_id)`, with `evidence_id,kind,source_time,received_at,quality,role,exclusion,source_id,envelope_sha256,assessment_revision_id`; `exclusion` is W2-03's SUPPORT/CONTEXT/EXCLUDED reason or null. Keep a record in the list when excluded, label why, and link to the existing Site Evidence exact record when source gate permits. `claim_rules` lists rule ID `cold-excursion/1` or `cold-start-response/1`, requirement, observed/missing role, coverage and resulting limit, all derived from the selected assessment; no speculative prose rule. Opaque cursor encodes `(source_time,evidence_id)` and selected basis SHA; mismatch returns 409 rather than changing pages.

-`PostgresColdConsequenceStore` alone inserts `cold_consequence_revision`, `cold_consequence_evidence` and `cold_consequence_work_attempt`. `cold_recompute.process_one` selects unfinished work under `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cold_consequence:' || work_id,0))`, takes one repeatable-read snapshot, refuses a foreign/missing exact basis, writes consequence/links and `SUCCEEDED` attempt in one transaction.  ## Five API reads
 
-`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{code}/cold`. Request query for all is `from,to,known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `after,limit` (default 50, max 200). Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. 401 unauthenticated, 403 tenant/source disclosure, 404 missing/wrong-type Site, 409 unresolved selected revision or cursor/basis conflict, 422 malformed/range/unknown query, 503 store unavailable use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.
+`cold_site_api.py:build_cold_site_router` mounts five GET paths below `/api/sites/{site_code}/cold`. Request query for all is optional paired `from,to`, optional `known_at` (strict UTC); Analysis additionally `cursor,limit` (default 50, max 200), matching W2-03's paging spelling. Use W2-03 shared common envelope exactly: `site_id,window:{from,to,known_at},currentness:{state,watermark,latest_relevant_evidence_at,pending_since},source_provenance:{classification,source_ids,evidence_ids,basis_sha256},limitations`. Every card/object includes `as_of` and `limitation`; scalar decimals serialize as decimal strings and absent values as JSON null. `currentness.state` is `CURRENT|PENDING_RECOMPUTE|STALE_SOURCE|HISTORICAL|UNKNOWN`. Valid empty selection is 200 with `UNKNOWN` and empty arrays. Use one selected repeatable-read snapshot for W2-03, source disclosure and consequence heads. No previous consequence becomes a current money claim while a relevant cold work item is queued or failed. Errors use `{error:{code,message}}`; never downgrade 503 into a blank page.
 
+Refusal code contract (same scope and parse semantics as `cold_assessment_api.py:build_cold_assessment_router`): 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`; 403 `SITE_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN` or `COLD_SOURCE_DISCLOSURE_FORBIDDEN`; 404 `SITE_NOT_FOUND`; 409 `COLD_SELECTION_UNSETTLED` for an explicitly requested revision that has no settled exact basis or `COLD_CURSOR_BASIS_CHANGED` for a changed Analysis basis; 422 `COLD_TIME_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_INVALID`, `COLD_WINDOW_TOO_LONG`, `COLD_PARAMETER_UNKNOWN`, `COLD_LIMIT_INVALID`, or `COLD_CURSOR_INVALID`; 503 `COLD_READ_UNAVAILABLE`. A wrong-type/foreign Site is 404 after access is checked. An absent optional current basis is 200 `UNKNOWN`, not a 409. Analysis cursor is unpadded base64url of sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON `{basis:<64 lowercase hex>,id:<UUID string>,t:<UTC instant>}`; malformed is 422 and an exact basis mismatch is 409. No arbitrary `after` offset or page across a changed basis.

 ## Selection, projection and capability
 
-One `ColdSelection` has `tenant_id,site_id,code,from_at,to_at,known_at,watermark,foundation_revision_ids,binding_revision_ids,assessment_revision_id,finding_revision_ids,source_gate`. `from_at` and `to_at` are UTC and half-open; `known_at` defaults to latest committed disposition watermark captured once at request start. The effective Foundation/binding is selected at each evidence source time (W2-03), with the selected policy at the requested window; conflicting/absent effective revision is an explicit limitation. 31 days maximum. No newer assessment, Finding or consequence may be silently mixed with an older `known_at`.
